XmlFragment.comment: The ROOT fragment subject <{subject}#frag> — rdf:type mdoc:XmlFragment, carries mnemo:documentId + one mdoc:childNode per top-level block (mdoc:childNode is multi). The tree ROOT; has NO mdoc:siblingOrder (only children get one, set by the parent loop). Code-defined span (rdf_document_tree::document_tree_triples). DERIVED flat.

mdoc:childNode.comment: RECURSIVE TREE EDGE — sh:node recursion is SHACL-INEXPRESSIBLE in rudof 0.2.12; childNode-target existence is reconcile-guaranteed + oracle-checked

Paragraph.comment: A block node <{subject}#block-{id}> or <{subject}#node-{n}> — rdf:type mdoc:Paragraph. Carries mnemo:documentId, mdoc:nodeId (block_id), optional mdoc:textContent, the recursive mdoc:childNode edges, and mdoc:siblingOrder (set by its parent's enumerate loop). The optional attribute predicates (level/href/target/...) are declared so the closed shape permits the full block attribute span. DERIVED flat.

mdoc:siblingOrder.comment: set on the CHILD by the parent loop; absent on the root fragment

TextNode.comment: A leaf text node <{subject}#node-{n}> — rdf:type mdoc:TextNode. Carries mnemo:documentId, mdoc:content (the text), and mdoc:siblingOrder (set by its parent loop). A leaf: NO mdoc:childNode. Code-defined span (serialize_tree_node text branch). DERIVED flat.

comment: EA-2b+ SHACL retrofit contract for the DOCUMENT-TREE Meaningful Object (structural fork: a RECURSIVE TREE via mdoc:childNode, and the bare doc subject has NO rdf:type). NOT a served emporium pack — an AUTHORED mirror of the code-defined document_tree_triples span, whose sole consumer is vocab_to_shacl. SCOPE: the projection emits TYPED node subjects (each child carries rdf:type mdoc:{TagName}); this contract declares the node classes a representative tree exercises (XmlFragment + Paragraph + TextNode), each as an independent flat closed sh:NodeShape. The full mdoc:{TagName} class space (Heading/CodeBlock/Link/...) shares the SAME flat derivation. TWO things are SHACL-INEXPRESSIBLE here and stay reconcile-guaranteed + oracle-checked, NOT silently skipped: (1) the RECURSIVE tree (sh:node) — rudof 0.2.12 has no recursive node shapes; childNode-target existence is checked by a SPARQL read-back in the oracle; (2) the BARE doc subject <{subject}> (no rdf:type) is NOT emitted by document_tree_triples (other faces write it), so no node-shape targets it — out of scope for the tree-face oracle. mnemo: is MNEMO_NS, mdoc: is MDOC_NS.
description: A document tree: a typed-node DAG rooted at mdoc:XmlFragment, with mdoc:childNode edges, sibling ordering, and per-node-type attribute predicates.
